name: Bulk dinner planner
pitch: Plan a week of dinners using ingredients from a single bulk store trip.
instructions: Start by searching for bulk recipes that use a small set of core ingredients. When you have a list of recipes, group them into a weekly menu. Create a table showing each day's dinner and the required ingredients. If a recipe calls for an ingredient not in the bulk haul, note it and suggest a swap. Show the table to the person and ask if they want to keep, change, or drop any meals. When the person approves, write the final menu to a text file in their workspace. If no recipes are found, say so and ask if they want to try a different approach.

examples.ask: can you plan dinners for the week?
examples.does: search for bulk recipes and show a table of options

skills.name: plan-weekly-meals
skills.description: Find bulk recipes and organise them into a week of dinners.
skills.body: 1. Use web_search to look for bulk recipes that share common ingredients. 2. Pick 7 recipes that fit the bulk haul. 3. List each dinner with its main ingredients. 4. If an ingredient is missing, suggest a swap or remove that meal. 5. Show the person a table of the week's dinners. 6. Ask if they want to keep or change anything. 7. When they say yes, use file_write to save the menu as a text file.

readme:
# bulk dinner planner
Plan a week of dinners using ingredients from a single bulk store trip.

What it does: searches for recipes that share core ingredients, organises them into a weekly menu, and shows a table of dinners and ingredients.

What it needs: web_search to find recipes, make_page to display the table, file_write to save the menu.

What it will not do: it cannot buy the ingredients or cook the meals.
